subsection {* f32 IEEE-754 Single Precision Model *}

typedef f32 = "{x::32 word. True}"
  by simp

setup_lifting type_definition_f32

definition f32_of_word :: "32 word ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_of_word w = Abs_f32 w"

definition f32_to_word :: "f32 ⇒ 32 word" where
  "f32_to_word x = Rep_f32 x"

definition f32_of_real :: "real ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_of_real r = f32_of_word (word_of_int (float_to_ieee754 (real_of_float (Float.of_float r)) :: 32 word))"

definition f32_to_real :: "f32 ⇒ real" where
  "f32_to_real x = float_of_ieee754 (uint32_of_word (f32_to_word x))"

definition f32_add :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_add a b = f32_of_word (ieee754_add (f32_to_word a) (f32_to_word b))"

definition f32_sub :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_sub a b = f32_of_word (ieee754_sub (f32_to_word a) (f32_to_word b))"

definition f32_mul :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_mul a b = f32_of_word (ieee754_mul (f32_to_word a) (f32_to_word b))"

definition f32_div :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_div a b = f32_of_word (ieee754_div (f32_to_word a) (f32_to_word b))"

definition f32_sqrt :: "f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_sqrt a = f32_of_word (ieee754_sqrt (f32_to_word a))"

definition f32_exp :: "f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_exp a = f32_of_word (ieee754_exp (f32_to_word a))"

definition f32_clip :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_clip min x max = 
    (if f32_to_real x < f32_to_real min then min 
     else if f32_to_real x > f32_to_real max then max 
     else x)"

definition f32_is_finite :: "f32 ⇒ bool" where
  "f32_is_finite x = (ieee754_class (f32_to_word x) = IEIEE754_NORMAL ∨ 
                     ieee754_class (f32_to_word x) = IEIEE754_SUBNORMAL)"

definition f32_is_nan :: "f32 ⇒ bool" where
  "f32_is_nan x = (ieee754_class (f32_to_word x) = IEIEE754_NAN)"

definition f32_is_inf :: "f32 ⇒ bool" where
  "f32_is_inf x = (ieee754_class (f32_to_word x) = IEIEE754_INF ∨ 
                  ieee754_class (f32_to_word x) = IEIEE754_NEG_INF)"

lemma f32_add_correct: 
  "f32_to_real (f32_add a b) = float_of_ieee754 (ieee754_add (uint32_of_word (f32_to_word a)) (uint32_of_word (f32_to_word b)))"
  by (simp add: f32_add_def f32_to_word_def Rep_f32_inverse)

lemma f32_clip_correct:
  "f32_to_real (f32_clip min x max) = 
   (let r = f32_to_real x in 
    if r < f32_to_real min then f32_to_real min 
    else if r > f32_to_real max then f32_to_real max 
    else r)"
  by (simp add: f32_clip_def)

lemma f32_is_finite_correct:
  "f32_is_finite x ⟷ ¬ (f32_is_nan x ∨ f32_is_inf x)"
  by (auto simp: f32_is_finite_def f32_is_nan_def f32_is_inf_def ieee754_class.cases)

subsection {* Pure Tensor Abstraction *}

record Tensor =
  shape :: "nat list"
  data  :: "f32 list"

definition Tensor_inv :: "Tensor ⇒ bool" where
  "Tensor_inv T ⟷ 
   (length (shape T) = 2) ∧ 
   (length (data T) = (shape T ! 0) * (shape T ! 1))"

typedef Tensor_set = "{T::Tensor. Tensor_inv T}"
  by (auto simp: Tensor_inv_def)

setup_lifting type_definition_Tensor_set

lift_definition pure_shape :: "Tensor_set ⇒ nat list" is shape .
lift_definition pure_data :: "Tensor_set ⇒ f32 list" is data .

lemma pure_shape_correct: 
  assumes "T ∈ Tensor_set"
  shows "length (pure_shape T) = 2 ∧ 
         length (pure_data T) = (pure_shape T ! 0) * (pure_shape T ! 1)"
  using assms by (transfer, simp add: Tensor_inv_def)

lemma pure_shape_index:
  assumes "T ∈ Tensor_set" and "i < length (pure_shape T)"
  shows "pure_shape T ! i < length (pure_data T)"
  using assms by (transfer, auto simp: Tensor_inv_def)

primrec pure_index :: "Tensor_set ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32" where
  "pure_index T i j = pure_data T ! (i * (pure_shape T ! 1) + j)"

lemma pure_index_correct:
  assumes "T ∈ Tensor_set" and "i < pure_shape T ! 0" and "j < pure_shape T ! 1"
  shows "pure_index T i j = pure_data T ! (i * (pure_shape T ! 1) + j)"
  using assms by (simp add: pure_index)

definition pure_zeros :: "nat list ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_zeros ds ≡ 
   let n = ds ! 0 * ds ! 1;
       zeros = replicate n 0.0
   in Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = ds, data = zeros ⦈)"

lemma pure_zeros_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "length ds = 2"
  shows "pure_zeros ds ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_zeros_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

definition pure_transpose :: "Tensor_set ⇒ nat list ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_transpose T perm ≡ 
   let old_shape = pure_shape T;
       new_shape = map (λi. old_shape ! i) perm;
       old_rows = old_shape ! 0;
       old_cols = old_shape ! 1;
       new_rows = new_shape ! 0;
       new_cols = new_shape ! 1;
       mat = λi j. pure_index T 
                  (if perm ! 0 = 0 then i else j) 
                  (if perm ! 1 = 0 then i else j);
       new_data = concat (map (λi. map (mat i) [0..<new_cols]) [0..<new_rows])
   in Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = new_shape, data = new_data ⦈)"

lemma pure_transpose_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "T ∈ Tensor_set" and "length perm = 2" and "set perm = {0,1}"
  shows "pure_transpose T perm ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_transpose_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

definition pure_matmul :: "Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_matmul A B ≡ 
   let a_shape = pure_shape A;
       b_shape = pure_shape B;
       a_rows = a_shape ! 0;
       a_cols = a_shape ! 1;
       b_rows = b_shape ! 0;
       b_cols = b_shape ! 1;
       c_rows = a_rows;
       c_cols = b_cols;
       matmul_entry = λi j. 
         ∑k< a_cols. f32_mul (pure_index A i k) (pure_index B k j);
       c_data = concat (map (λi. map (matmul_entry i) [0..<c_cols]) [0..<c_rows])
   in Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = [c_rows, c_cols], data = c_data ⦈)"

lemma pure_matmul_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "A ∈ Tensor_set" and "B ∈ Tensor_set" 
    and "pure_shape A ! 1 = pure_shape B ! 0"
  shows "pure_matmul A B ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_matmul_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

definition pure_add :: "Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_add A B ≡ 
   let shape = pure_shape A;
       data = zip_with f32_add (pure_data A) (pure_data B)
   in Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = shape, data = data ⦈)"

lemma pure_add_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "A ∈ Tensor_set" and "B ∈ Tensor_set" and "pure_shape A = pure_shape B"
  shows "pure_add A B ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_add_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

definition pure_sub :: "Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_sub A B ≡ 
   let shape = pure_shape A;
       data = zip_with f32_sub (pure_data A) (pure_data B)
   in Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = shape, data = data ⦈)"

lemma pure_sub_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "A ∈ Tensor_set" and "B ∈ Tensor_set" and "pure_shape A = pure_shape B"
  shows "pure_sub A B ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_sub_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

definition pure_div :: "Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_div A B ≡ 
   let shape = pure_shape A;
       data = zip_with f32_div (pure_data A) (pure_data B)
   in Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = shape, data = data ⦈)"

lemma pure_div_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "A ∈ Tensor_set" and "B ∈ Tensor_set" and "pure_shape A = pure_shape B"
    and "∀x∈set (pure_data B). x ≠ 0.0 ∧ f32_is_finite x"
  shows "pure_div A B ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_div_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

definition pure_clip :: "Tensor_set ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_clip T min max ≡ 
   let shape = pure_shape T;
       data = map (f32_clip min max) (pure_data T)
   in Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = shape, data = data ⦈)"

lemma pure_clip_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "T ∈ Tensor_set"
  shows "pure_clip T min max ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_clip_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

definition pure_exp :: "Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_exp T ≡ 
   let shape = pure_shape T;
       data = map f32_exp (pure_data T)
   in Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = shape, data = data ⦈)"

lemma pure_exp_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "T ∈ Tensor_set"
  shows "pure_exp T ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_exp_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

definition pure_copy :: "Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_copy T ≡ Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = pure_shape T, data = pure_data T ⦈)"

lemma pure_copy_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "T ∈ Tensor_set"
  shows "pure_copy T ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_copy_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

definition pure_scale :: "Tensor_set ⇒ f32 ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_scale T s ≡ 
   let shape = pure_shape T;
       data = map (f32_mul s) (pure_data T)
   in Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = shape, data = data ⦈)"

lemma pure_scale_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "T ∈ Tensor_set"
  shows "pure_scale T s ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_scale_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

primrec pure_sum_list :: "f32 list ⇒ f32" where
  "pure_sum_list [] = 0.0" |
  "pure_sum_list (x#xs) = f32_add x (pure_sum_list xs)"

definition pure_mean :: "Tensor_set ⇒ f32" where
  "pure_mean T = 
   let n = of_nat (length (pure_data T));
       s = pure_sum_list (pure_data T)
   in f32_div s (f32_of_real (real_of_nat (length (pure_data T))))"

definition pure_split :: "Tensor_set ⇒ nat ⇒ Tensor_set × Tensor_set" where
  "pure_split T dim ≡ 
   let old_shape = pure_shape T;
       old_rows = old_shape ! 0;
       old_cols = old_shape ! 1;
       x1_data = map (λi. nth (pure_data T) i) 
                    (concat (map (λb. map (λd. b * old_cols + d) [0..<dim]) [0..<old_rows]));
       x2_data = map (λi. nth (pure_data T) i) 
                    (concat (map (λb. map (λd. b * old_cols + dim + d) [0..<dim]) [0..<old_rows]))
   in (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = [old_rows, dim], data = x1_data ⦈),
       Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = [old_rows, dim], data = x2_data ⦈))"

lemma pure_split_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "T ∈ Tensor_set" and "old_cols = 2 * dim" and "dim > 0"
  shows "fst (pure_split T dim) ∈ Tensor_set ∧ snd (pure_split T dim) ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_split_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

definition pure_merge :: "Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set ⇒ Tensor_set" where
  "pure_merge x1 x2 ≡ 
   let x1_shape = pure_shape x1;
       x2_shape = pure_shape x2;
       rows = x1_shape ! 0;
       dim = x1_shape ! 1;
       out_shape = [rows, 2 * dim];
       out_data = concat (map (λb. 
                          (map (λd. pure_index x1 b d) [0..<dim]) @
                          (map (λd. pure_index x2 b d) [0..<dim]))
                        [0..<rows])
   in Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = out_shape, data = out_data ⦈)"

lemma pure_merge_Tensor_inv:
  assumes "x1 ∈ Tensor_set" and "x2 ∈ Tensor_set" 
    and "pure_shape x1 = pure_shape x2" 
    and "pure_shape x1 ! 1 = dim"
  shows "pure_merge x1 x2 ∈ Tensor_set"
  using assms by (auto simp: pure_merge_def Tensor_inv_def Abs_Tensor_set_inverse)

subsection {* Imperative Heap Model *}

type_synonym heap = "nat ⇒ (nat list × f32 list) option"

definition heap_Tensor :: "heap ⇒ nat ⇒ bool" where
  "heap_Tensor h p ≡ (∃sh da. h p = Some (sh, da) ∧ length sh = 2 ∧ length da = sh ! 0 * sh ! 1)"

definition heap_valid :: "heap ⇒ bool" where
  "heap_valid h ≡ ∀p. h p = None ∨ heap_Tensor h p"

definition heap_ disjoint :: "heap ⇒ heap ⇒ bool" where
  "heap_disjoint h1 h2 ≡ ∀p. h1 p = None ∨ h2 p = None"

definition heap_union :: "heap ⇒ heap ⇒ heap" where
  "heap_union h1 h2 ≡ λp. case h1 p of Some x ⇒ Some x | None ⇒ h2 p"

lemma heap_unionI1: "heap_Tensor h1 p ⟹ heap_Tensor (heap_union h1 h2) p"
  by (auto simp: heap_union_def heap_Tensor_def split: option.splits)

lemma heap_unionI2: "heap_Tensor h2 p ⟹ heap_disjoint h1 h2 ⟹ heap_Tensor (heap_union h1 h2) p"
  by (auto simp: heap_union_def heap_disjoint_def heap_Tensor_def split: option.splits)

definition heap_alloc :: "nat list ⇒ f32 list ⇒ heap ⇒ (nat × heap)" where
  "heap_alloc sh da h ≡ 
   (let p = Max (set (dom h)) + 1 in (p, h(p ↦ (sh, da))))"

lemma heap_alloc_heap_Tensor:
  assumes "length sh = 2" and "length da = sh ! 0 * sh ! 1"
  shows "heap_Tensor (snd (heap_alloc sh da h)) (fst (heap_alloc sh da h))"
  using assms unfolding heap_alloc_def heap_Tensor_def
  by (auto simp: split_beta')

definition heap_read :: "heap ⇒ nat ⇒ (nat list × f32 list)" where
  "heap_read h p = (case h p of Some x ⇒ x)"

lemma heap_read_heap_Tensor:
  assumes "heap_Tensor h p"
  shows "heap_read h p = (sh, da) ⟹ length sh = 2 ∧ length da = sh ! 0 * sh ! 1"
  using assms by (auto simp: heap_Tensor_def heap_read_def split: option.splits)

definition heap_write :: "heap ⇒ nat ⇒ nat list ⇒ f32 list ⇒ heap" where
  "heap_write h p sh da ≡ h(p ↦ (sh, da))"

lemma heap_write_heap_Tensor:
  assumes "length sh = 2" and "length da = sh ! 0 * sh ! 1"
  shows "heap_Tensor (heap_write h p sh da) p"
  using assms by (auto simp: heap_Tensor_def heap_write_def)

definition heap_free :: "heap ⇒ nat ⇒ heap" where
  "heap_free h p ≡ h(p := None)"

lemma heap_free_heap_not:
  "heap_Tensor (heap_free h p) p ⟷ False"
  by (auto simp: heap_Tensor_def heap_free_def)

subsection {* Imperative Tensor Operations *}

definition t_zeros :: "nat list ⇒ (nat × heap, err) result" where
  "t_zeros ds ≡ 
   if length ds ≠ 2 then Error ShapeMismatch
   else
     let n = ds ! 0 * ds ! 1;
         da = replicate n 0.0
     in do {
       (p, h') ← heap_alloc ds da;
       return (p, h')
     }"

lemma t_zeros_correct:
  assumes "heap_valid h" and "length ds = 2"
  shows "∃p h'. run (t_zeros ds) h = Ok ((p, h'), h'') ∧ heap_Tensor h'' p ∧ 
              pure_shape (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = ds, data = replicate (ds ! 0 * ds ! 1) 0.0 ⦈)) = ds"
  using assms by (auto simp: t_zeros_def heap_valid_def heap_alloc_heap_Tensor)

definition t_transpose :: "nat ⇒ nat list ⇒ (nat × heap, err) result" where
  "t_transpose p perm ≡ 
   do {
     (sh, da) ← return (heap_read undefined p);
     if length sh ≠ 2 ∨ length perm ≠ 2 ∨ set perm ≠ {0,1} then 
       Error ShapeMismatch
     else
       let old_rows = sh ! 0;
           old_cols = sh ! 1;
           new_rows = sh ! (perm ! 0);
           new_cols = sh ! (perm ! 1);
           mat = λi j. da ! (if perm ! 0 = 0 then i * old_cols + j else j * old_rows + i);
           new_da = concat (map (λi. map (mat i) [0..<new_cols]) [0..<new_rows])
       in do {
         (p', h') ← heap_alloc [new_rows, new_cols] new_da;
         return (p', h')
       }
   }"

lemma t_transpose_correct:
  assumes "heap_Tensor h p" and "length perm = 2" and "set perm = {0,1}"
  shows "∃p' h'. run (t_transpose p perm) h = Ok ((p', h'), h'') ∧ 
              pure_transpose (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h p), data = snd (heap_read h p) ⦈)) perm = 
              Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h' p'), data = snd (heap_read h' p') ⦈)"
  using assms by (auto simp: t_transpose_def heap_Tensor_def heap_read_def heap_alloc_heap_Tensor pure_transpose_def)

definition t_matmul :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (nat × heap, err) result" where
  "t_matmul pA pB ≡ 
   do {
     (shA, daA) ← return (heap_read undefined pA);
     (shB, daB) ← return (heap_read undefined pB);
     if length shA ≠ 2 ∨ length shB ≠ 2 ∨ shA ! 1 ≠ shB ! 0 then 
       Error ShapeMismatch
     else
       let a_rows = shA ! 0;
           a_cols = shA ! 1;
           b_rows = shB ! 0;
           b_cols = shB ! 1;
           c_rows = a_rows;
           c_cols = b_cols;
           matmul_entry = λi j. 
             ∑k< a_cols. f32_mul (daA ! (i * a_cols + k)) (daB ! (k * b_cols + j));
           c_da = concat (map (λi. map (matmul_entry i) [0..<c_cols]) [0..<c_rows])
       in do {
         (pC, h') ← heap_alloc [c_rows, c_cols] c_da;
         return (pC, h')
       }
   }"

lemma t_matmul_correct:
  assumes "heap_Tensor h pA" and "heap_Tensor h pB" 
    and "pure_shape (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h pA), data = snd (heap_read h pA) ⦈)) ! 1 = 
         pure_shape (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h pB), data = snd (heap_read h pB) ⦈)) ! 0"
  shows "∃pC h'. run (t_matmul pA pB) h = Ok ((pC, h'), h'') ∧ 
              pure_matmul (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h pA), data = snd (heap_read h pA) ⦈))
                          (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h pB), data = snd (heap_read h pB) ⦈)) =
              Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h' pC), data = snd (heap_read h' pC) ⦈)"
  using assms by (auto simp: t_matmul_def heap_Tensor_def heap_read_def heap_alloc_heap_Tensor pure_matmul_def)

definition t_add :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (nat × heap, err) result" where
  "t_add pA pB ≡ 
   do {
     (shA, daA) ← return (heap_read undefined pA);
     (shB, daB) ← return (heap_read undefined pB);
     if shA ≠ shB then Error ShapeMismatch
     else do {
       let da = zip_with f32_add daA daB;
       (pC, h') ← heap_alloc shA da;
       return (pC, h')
     }
   }"

lemma t_add_correct:
  assumes "heap_Tensor h pA" and "heap_Tensor h pB" 
    and "fst (heap_read h pA) = fst (heap_read h pB)"
  shows "∃pC h'. run (t_add pA pB) h = Ok ((pC, h'), h'') ∧ 
              pure_add (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h pA), data = snd (heap_read h pA) ⦈))
                       (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h pB), data = snd (heap_read h pB) ⦈)) =
              Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h' pC), data = snd (heap_read h' pC) ⦈)"
  using assms by (auto simp: t_add_def heap_Tensor_def heap_read_def heap_alloc_heap_Tensor pure_add_def)

definition t_sub :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (nat × heap, err) result" where
  "t_sub pA pB ≡ 
   do {
     (shA, daA) ← return (heap_read undefined pA);
     (shB, daB) ← return (heap_read undefined pB);
     if shA ≠ shB then Error ShapeMismatch
     else do {
       let da = zip_with f32_sub daA daB;
       (pC, h') ← heap_alloc shA da;
       return (pC, h')
     }
   }"

lemma t_sub_correct:
  assumes "heap_Tensor h pA" and "heap_Tensor h pB" 
    and "fst (heap_read h pA) = fst (heap_read h pB)"
  shows "∃pC h'. run (t_sub pA pB) h = Ok ((pC, h'), h'') ∧ 
              pure_sub (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h pA), data = snd (heap_read h pA) ⦈))
                       (Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h pB), data = snd (heap_read h pB) ⦈)) =
              Abs_Tensor_set (⦇ shape = fst (heap_read h' pC), data = snd (heap_read h' pC) ⦈)"
  using assms by (auto simp: t_sub_def heap_Tensor_def heap_read_def heap_alloc_heap_Tensor pure_sub_def)

definition t_div :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (nat × heap, err) result" where
  "t_div pA pB ≡ 
   do {
     (shA, daA) ← return (heap_read undefined pA);
     (shB, daB) ← return (heap_read undefined pB);
     if shA ≠ shB then Error ShapeMismatch
     else if ∃d ∈ set daB. d = 0.0 ∨ ¬ f32_is_finite d then 
       Error NumericFailure
     else do {
       let da = zip_with f32_div daA daB;
       (pC, h') ← heap_alloc shA da;
       return (pC, h')
     }
   }"

lemma t_div_correct:
  assumes "heap_Tensor h pA" and "heap_Tensor h pB" 
    and "fst (heap_read h pA) = fst (heap_read h pB)"
    and "∀d ∈ set (snd (heap_read h pB)). d ≠ 0.0 ∧ f32_is_finite d"
  shows "∃pC h'. run (t_div pA pB) h = Ok ((pC, h'), h'') ∧

     else if length da ≠ sh ! 0 * sh ! 1 then return (Error DataLengthMismatch)
     else return (Ok ())
   }"

  "t_zeros_grad (p, h) shape ≡

   else do {
     (sh, da) ← heap_get p;
     if sh ≠ shape then return (Error ShapeMismatch)
     else do {
       mapM (λi. heap_update p i 0.0) [0..<length da];
       return (Ok ())
     }
   }"

subsection {* RSFLayer State *}

record RSFLayer_state =
  s_weight :: nat
  t_weight :: nat
  s_bias :: nat
  t_bias :: nat
  s_weight_grad :: nat
  t_weight_grad :: nat
  s_bias_grad :: nat
  t_bias_grad :: nat
  dim :: nat
  allocator :: heap
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  grad_mean :: bool
  freed :: "nat × bool"  (* (pointer, freed flag) *)

definition RSFLayer_valid :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ bool" where
  "RSFLayer_valid s ≡ 
   let h = allocator s in
   heap_valid h ∧
   heap_Tensor h (s_weight s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (t_weight s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (s_bias s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (t_bias s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (s_weight_grad s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (t_weight_grad s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (s_bias_grad s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (t_bias_grad s) ∧
   (case s_weight s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case t_weight s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case s_bias s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case t_bias s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case s_weight_grad s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case t_weight_grad s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case s_bias_grad s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case t_bias_grad s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (snd (freed s) = False) ∧
   (fst (s_weight s) ≠ fst (t_weight s)) ∧
   (fst (s_weight s) ≠ fst (s_bias s)) ∧
   (fst (s_weight s) ≠ fst (t_bias s)) ∧
   (fst (t_weight s) ≠ fst (s_bias s)) ∧
   (fst (t_weight s) ≠ fst (t_bias s)) ∧
   (fst (s_bias s) ≠ fst (t_bias s)) ∧
   (fst (s_weight_grad s) ≠ fst (t_weight_grad s)) ∧
   (fst (s_weight_grad s) ≠ fst (s_bias_grad s)) ∧
   (fst (s_weight_grad s) ≠ fst (t_bias_grad s)) ∧
   (fst (t_weight_grad s) ≠ fst (s_bias_grad s)) ∧
   (fst (t_weight_grad s) ≠ fst (t_bias_grad s)) ∧
   (fst (s_bias_grad s) ≠ fst (t_bias_grad s))"

definition RSFLayer_shape_invariants :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ bool" where
  "RSFLayer_shape_invariants s ≡ 
   let h = allocator s in
   (case heap_read h (fst (s_weight s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [dim s, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (t_weight s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [dim s, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (s_bias s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [1, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (t_bias s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [1, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (s_weight_grad s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [dim s, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (t_weight_grad s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [dim s, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (s_bias_grad s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [1, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (t_bias_grad s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [1, dim s])"

definition RSFLayer_private_disjoint :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ bool" where
  "RSFLayer_private_disjoint s ≡ 
   let h = allocator s in
   heap_disjoint (heap_singleton (fst (s_weight s)) (heap_read h (fst (s_weight s)))) 
                 (heap_singleton (fst (t_weight s)) (heap_read h (fst (t_weight s)))) ∧
   heap_disjoint (heap_singleton (fst (s_weight s)) (heap_read h (fst (s_weight s)))) 
                 (heap_singleton (fst (s_bias s)) (heap_read h (fst (s_bias s)))) ∧
   ... (* all pairs disjoint *)"

definition RSFLayer_wellformed :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ bool" where
  "RSFLayer_wellformed s ≡ 
   RSFLayer_valid s ∧
   RSFLayer_shape_invariants s ∧
   RSFLayer_private_disjoint s"

subsection {* RSFLayer Operations *}

definition t_RSFLayer_init :: "nat ⇒ nat × heap ⇒ (RSFLayer_state, err) result" where
  "t_RSFLayer_init dim alloc ≡ 
   if dim = 0 then return (Error InvalidDimension)
   else do {
     h ← return alloc;
     (s_w_p, h1) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h;
     (t_w_p, h2) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h1;
     (s_b_p, h3) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h2;
     (t_b_p, h4) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h3;
     (s_w_g_p, h5) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h4;
     (t_w_g_p, h6) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h5;
     (s_b_g_p, h7) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h6;
     (t_b_g_p, h8) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h7;
     return (⦇ 
       s_weight = s_w_p, t_weight = t_w_p, s_bias = s_b_p, t_bias = t_b_p,
       s_weight_grad = s_w_g_p, t_weight_grad = t_w_g_p, s_bias_grad = s_b_g_p, t_bias_grad = t_b_g_p,
       dim = dim, allocator = h8, clip_min = -5.0, clip_max = 5.0, grad_mean = True, freed = (0, False) ⦈)
   }"

definition t_RSFLayer_initWithConfig :: "nat ⇒ RSFLayerConfig ⇒ nat × heap ⇒ (RSFLayer_state, err) result" where
  "t_RSFLayer_initWithConfig dim cfg alloc ≡ 
   if dim = 0 then return (Error InvalidDimension)
   else if ¬ f32_is_finite cfg.clip_min ∨ ¬ f32_is_finite cfg.clip_max then return (Error NonFinite)
   else if ¬ (f32_to_real cfg.clip_min < f32_to_real cfg.clip_max) then return (Error InvalidConfig)
   else do {
     h ← return alloc;
     let fan_in = f32_of_real (real_of_nat dim);
         fan_out = fan_in;
         fan_sum = f32_add fan_in fan_out;
         xavier_bound = f32_sqrt (f32_div (f32_of_real 6.0) fan_sum);
     (s_w_p, h1) ← t_randomUniform [dim, dim] (- xavier_bound) xavier_bound (cfg.seed_offset + 42) h;
     (t_w_p, h2) ← t_randomUniform [dim, dim] (- xavier_bound) xavier_bound (cfg.seed_offset + 43) h1;
     (s_b_p, h3) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h2;
     (t_b_p, h4) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h3;
     (s_w_g_p, h5) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h4;
     (t_w_g_p, h6) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h5;
     (s_b_g_p, h7) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h6;
     (t_b_g_p, h8) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h7;
     return (⦇ 
       s_weight = s_w_p, t_weight = t_w_p, s_bias = s_b_p, t_bias = t_b_p,
       s_weight_grad = s_w_g_p, t_weight_grad = t_w_g_p, s_bias_grad = s_b_g_p, t_bias_grad = t_b_g_p,
       dim = dim, allocator = h8, clip_min = cfg.clip_min, clip_max = cfg.clip_max, 
       grad_mean = cfg.grad_mean, freed = (0, False) ⦈)
   }"

definition t_RSFLayer_deinit :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ (unit, err) Heap" where
  "t_RSFLayer_deinit s ≡ 
   if snd (freed s) then return (Ok ())
   else do {
     _ ← t_free (fst (s_weight s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (t_weight s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (s_bias s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (t_bias s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (s_weight_grad s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (t_weight_grad s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (s_bias_grad s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (t_bias_grad s)) (allocator s);
     return (Ok (s⦇ freed := (fst (freed s), True) ⦈))
   }"

definition t_RSFLayer_zeroGradients :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ (unit, err) Heap" where
  "t_RSFLayer_zeroGradients s ≡ 
   do {
     _ ← t_zeros_grad (s_weight_grad s, allocator s) [dim s, dim s];
     _ ← t_zeros_grad (t_weight_grad s, allocator s) [dim s, dim s];
     _ ← t_zeros_grad (s_bias_grad s, allocator s) [1, dim s];
     _ ← t_zeros_grad (t_bias_grad s, allocator s) [1, dim s];
     return (Ok ())
   }"

definition t_RSFLayer_assertPair :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (nat, err) Heap" where
  "t_RSFLayer_assertPair s p1 p2 ≡ 
   do {
     _ ← t_assert2DAndLen p1 (allocator s);
     _ ← t_assert2DAndLen p2 (allocator s);
     (sh1, _) ← heap_get p1 (allocator s);
     (sh2, _) ← heap_get p2 (allocator s);
     if sh1 ! 1 ≠ dim s ∨ sh2 ! 1 ≠ dim s then return (Error ShapeMismatch)
     else if sh1 ! 0 ≠ sh2 ! 0 then return (Error ShapeMismatch)
     else if (case heap_read (allocator s) (fst (s_bias s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ length sh ≠ 1 ∨ sh ! 1 ≠ dim s) 
          ∨ (case heap_read (allocator s) (fst (t_bias s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ length sh ≠ 1 ∨ sh ! 1 ≠ dim s) 
     then return (Error ShapeMismatch)
     else if ¬ f32_is_finite (clip_min s) ∨ ¬ f32_is_finite (clip_max s) 
     then return (Error NonFinite)
     else if ¬ (f32_to_real (clip_min s) < f32_to_real (clip_max s)) 
     then return (Error InvalidConfig)
     else return (Ok (sh1 ! 0))
   }"

definition t_RSFLayer_forward :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (unit, err) Heap" where
  "t_RSFLayer_forward s x1_p x2_p ≡ 
   do {
     batch_size ← t_RSFLayer_assertPair s x1_p x2_p;
     (* x2_t = x2.transpose([1,0]) *)
     (x2_t_p, _) ← t_transpose x2_p [1,0] (allocator s);
     (* s_x2_t = s_weight.matmul(x2_t) *)
     (s_x2_t_p, _) ← t_matmul (fst (s_weight s)) x2_t_p (allocator s);
     (* s_x2 = s_x2_t.transpose([1,0]) *)
     (s_x2_p, _) ← t_transpose s_x2_t_p [1,0] (allocator s);
     (* add bias: s_x2.data[b,d] += s_bias.data[d] *)
     _ ← t_inplace_scale_add s_x2_p (clip_min s) (fst (s_bias s)) batch_size (dim s);
     _ ← t_clamp_finite_inplace s_x2_p (allocator s);
     _ ← t_inplace_clip s_x2_p (clip_min s) (clip_max s) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_clamp_finite_inplace s_x2_p (allocator s);
     _ ← t_inplace_exp s_x2_p (allocator s);
     _ ← t_clamp_finite_inplace s_x2_p (allocator s);
     (* x1.data[b,d] *= s_x2.data[b,d] *)
     _ ← t_inplace_mul x1_p s_x2_p (allocator s);
     (* x1_t = x1.transpose([1,0]) *)
     (x1_t_p, _) ← t_transpose x1_p [1,0] (allocator s);
     (* t_x1_t = t_weight.matmul(x1_t) *)
     (t_x1_t_p, _) ← t_matmul (fst (t_weight s)) x1_t_p (allocator s);
     (* t_x1 = t_x1_t.transpose([1,0]) *)
     (t_x1_p, _) ← t_transpose t_x1_t_p [1,0] (allocator s);
     (* add bias: t_x1.data[b,d] += t_bias.data[d] *)
     _ ← t_inplace_scale_add t_x1_p (clip_min s) (fst (t_bias s)) batch_size (dim s);
     _ ← t_clamp_finite_inplace t_x1_p (allocator s);
     (* x2 = x2 + t_x1 *)
     _ ← t_inplace_add x2_p t_x1_p (allocator s);
     _ ← t_clamp_finite_inplace x2_p (allocator s);
     return (Ok ())
   }"

definition t_RSFLayer_inverse :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (unit, err) Heap" where
  "t_RSFLayer_inverse s y1_p y2_p ≡ 
   do {
     batch_size ← t_RSFLayer_assertPair s y1_p y2_p;
     (* y1_t = y1.transpose([1,0]) *)
     (y1_t_p, _) ← t_transpose y1_p [1,0] (allocator s);
     (* t_y1_t = t_weight.matmul(y1_t) *)
     (t_y1_t_p, _) ← t_matmul (fst (t_weight s)) y1_t_p (allocator s);
     (* t_y1 = t_y1_t.transpose([1,0]) *)
     (t_y1_p, _) ← t_transpose t_y1_t_p [1,0] (allocator s);
     (* add bias: t_y1.data[b,d] += t_bias.data[d] *)
     _ ← t_inplace_scale_add t_y1_p (clip_min s) (fst (t_bias s)) batch_size (dim s);
     _ ← t_clamp_finite_inplace t_y1_p (allocator s);
     (* y2 = y2 - t_y1 *)
     _ ← t_inplace_sub y2_p t_y1_p (allocator s);
     _ ← t_clamp_finite_inplace y2_p (allocator s);
     (* y2_t = y2.transpose([1,0]) *)

definition t_matmul :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (nat × heap, err) result" where
  "t_matmul pA pB ≡ 
   do {
     (shA, daA) ← return (heap_read undefined pA);
     (shB, daB) ← return (heap_read undefined pB);
     if length shA ≠ 2 ∨ length shB ≠ 2 ∨ shA ! 1 ≠ shB ! 0 then 
       Error ShapeMismatch
     else
       let a_rows = shA ! 0;
           a_cols = shA ! 1;
           b_rows = shB ! 0;
           b_cols = shB ! 1;
           c_rows = a_rows;
           c_cols = b_cols;
           matmul_entry = λi j. 
             ∑k< a_cols. f32_mul (daA ! (i * a_cols + k)) (daB ! (k * b_cols + j));
           c_da = concat (map (λi. map (matmul_entry i) [0..<c_cols]) [0..<c_rows])
       in do {
         (pC, h') ← heap_alloc [c_rows, c_cols] c_da;
         return (pC, h')
       }
   }"

  assumes "heap_Tensor h pA" and "heap_Tensor h pB"

subsection {* RSFLayer State *}

record RSFLayer_state =
  s_weight :: nat
  t_weight :: nat
  s_bias :: nat
  t_bias :: nat
  s_weight_grad :: nat
  t_weight_grad :: nat
  s_bias_grad :: nat
  t_bias_grad :: nat
  dim :: nat
  allocator :: heap
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  grad_mean :: bool
  freed :: "nat × bool"  (* (pointer, freed flag) *)

definition RSFLayer_valid :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ bool" where
  "RSFLayer_valid s ≡ 
   let h = allocator s in
   heap_valid h ∧
   heap_Tensor h (s_weight s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (t_weight s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (s_bias s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (t_bias s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (s_weight_grad s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (t_weight_grad s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (s_bias_grad s) ∧
   heap_Tensor h (t_bias_grad s) ∧
   (case s_weight s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case t_weight s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case s_bias s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case t_bias s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case s_weight_grad s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case t_weight_grad s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case s_bias_grad s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (case t_bias_grad s of (p, _) ⇒ h p ≠ None) ∧
   (snd (freed s) = False) ∧
   (fst (s_weight s) ≠ fst (t_weight s)) ∧
   (fst (s_weight s) ≠ fst (s_bias s)) ∧
   (fst (s_weight s) ≠ fst (t_bias s)) ∧
   (fst (t_weight s) ≠ fst (s_bias s)) ∧
   (fst (t_weight s) ≠ fst (t_bias s)) ∧
   (fst (s_bias s) ≠ fst (t_bias s)) ∧
   (fst (s_weight_grad s) ≠ fst (t_weight_grad s)) ∧
   (fst (s_weight_grad s) ≠ fst (s_bias_grad s)) ∧
   (fst (s_weight_grad s) ≠ fst (t_bias_grad s)) ∧
   (fst (t_weight_grad s) ≠ fst (s_bias_grad s)) ∧
   (fst (t_weight_grad s) ≠ fst (t_bias_grad s)) ∧
   (fst (s_bias_grad s) ≠ fst (t_bias_grad s))"

definition RSFLayer_shape_invariants :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ bool" where
  "RSFLayer_shape_invariants s ≡ 
   let h = allocator s in
   (case heap_read h (fst (s_weight s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [dim s, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (t_weight s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [dim s, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (s_bias s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [1, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (t_bias s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [1, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (s_weight_grad s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [dim s, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (t_weight_grad s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [dim s, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (s_bias_grad s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [1, dim s]) ∧
   (case heap_read h (fst (t_bias_grad s)) of (sh, _) ⇒ sh = [1, dim s])"

definition RSFLayer_private_disjoint :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ bool" where
  "RSFLayer_private_disjoint s ≡ 
   let h = allocator s in
   heap_disjoint (heap_singleton (fst (s_weight s)) (heap_read h (fst (s_weight s)))) 
                 (heap_singleton (fst (t_weight s)) (heap_read h (fst (t_weight s)))) ∧
   heap_disjoint (heap_singleton (fst (s_weight s)) (heap_read h (fst (s_weight s)))) 
                 (heap_singleton (fst (s_bias s)) (heap_read h (fst (s_bias s)))) ∧
   ... (* all pairs disjoint *)"

definition RSFLayer_wellformed :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ bool" where
  "RSFLayer_wellformed s ≡ 
   RSFLayer_valid s ∧
   RSFLayer_shape_invariants s ∧
   RSFLayer_private_disjoint s"

definition t_RSFLayer_init :: "nat ⇒ nat × heap ⇒ (RSFLayer_state, err) result" where
  "t_RSFLayer_init dim alloc ≡ 
   if dim = 0 then return (Error InvalidDimension)
   else do {
     h ← return alloc;
     (s_w_p, h1) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h;
     (t_w_p, h2) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h1;
     (s_b_p, h3) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h2;
     (t_b_p, h4) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h3;
     (s_w_g_p, h5) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h4;
     (t_w_g_p, h6) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h5;
     (s_b_g_p, h7) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h6;
     (t_b_g_p, h8) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h7;
     return (⦇ 
       s_weight = s_w_p, t_weight = t_w_p, s_bias = s_b_p, t_bias = t_b_p,
       s_weight_grad = s_w_g_p, t_weight_grad = t_w_g_p, s_bias_grad = s_b_g_p, t_bias_grad = t_b_g_p,
       dim = dim, allocator = h8, clip_min = -5.0, clip_max = 5.0, grad_mean = True, freed = (0, False) ⦈)
   }"

definition t_RSFLayer_initWithConfig :: "nat ⇒ RSFLayerConfig ⇒ nat × heap ⇒ (RSFLayer_state, err) result" where
  "t_RSFLayer_initWithConfig dim cfg alloc ≡ 
   if dim = 0 then return (Error InvalidDimension)
   else if ¬ f32_is_finite cfg.clip_min ∨ ¬ f32_is_finite cfg.clip_max then return (Error NonFinite)
   else if ¬ (f32_to_real cfg.clip_min < f32_to_real cfg.clip_max) then return (Error InvalidConfig)
   else do {
     h ← return alloc;
     let fan_in = f32_of_real (real_of_nat dim);
         fan_out = fan_in;
         fan_sum = f32_add fan_in fan_out;
         xavier_bound = f32_sqrt (f32_div (f32_of_real 6.0) fan_sum);
     (s_w_p, h1) ← t_randomUniform [dim, dim] (- xavier_bound) xavier_bound (cfg.seed_offset + 42) h;
     (t_w_p, h2) ← t_randomUniform [dim, dim] (- xavier_bound) xavier_bound (cfg.seed_offset + 43) h1;
     (s_b_p, h3) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h2;
     (t_b_p, h4) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h3;
     (s_w_g_p, h5) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h4;
     (t_w_g_p, h6) ← t_zeros [dim, dim] h5;
     (s_b_g_p, h7) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h6;
     (t_b_g_p, h8) ← t_zeros [1, dim] h7;
     return (⦇ 
       s_weight = s_w_p, t_weight = t_w_p, s_bias = s_b_p, t_bias = t_b_p,
       s_weight_grad = s_w_g_p, t_weight_grad = t_w_g_p, s_bias_grad = s_b_g_p, t_bias_grad = t_b_g_p,
       dim = dim, allocator = h8, clip_min = cfg.clip_min, clip_max = cfg.clip_max, 
       grad_mean = cfg.grad_mean, freed = (0, False) ⦈)
   }"

definition t_RSFLayer_deinit :: "RSFLayer_state ⇒ (unit, err) Heap" where
  "t_RSFLayer_deinit s ≡ 
   if snd (freed s) then return (Ok ())
   else do {
     _ ← t_free (fst (s_weight s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (t_weight s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (s_bias s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (t_bias s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (s_weight_grad s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (t_weight_grad s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (s_bias_grad s)) (allocator s);
     _ ← t_free (fst (t_bias_grad s)) (allocator s);
     return (Ok (s⦇ freed := (fst (freed s), True) ⦈))
   }"
